Commentary.Commentary: We are ready for the run chase. The umpires are out in the middle, followed by the India Women team. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney are the openers for Australia Women. Shikha Pandey to start proceedings with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now the target is not a big one, however, the last over has given India some momentum but can they carry forward that when they come out to bowl? They will have to as they will need wickets and a lot of them in quick succession. Australia on the other hand, will fancy themselves to chase this down with ease. Join us for the second essay in a bit.

A superb performance then by Australia! The hosts will be a little disappointed with their effort towards the end but overall they have justified their skipper's decision to bowl first. Right from the word go, they were on the money. It was Vlaeminck at the start who got both the openers quickly and then it was the spinners through the middle overs who kept the pressure going. India also helped as the running was extremely poor, two run outs at crucial stages did not help their cause. Their top scorer was Pooja who walked in at number 8 and had it not been for her, the visitors would have fallen well short of 100.

FOUR! Length again, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar dances down the track and drags the ball from outside off. She pierces the gap between long on and deep mid-wicket perfectly to end with another boundary. India Women finish with 118/9.
A length ball, on off. Pooja Vastrakar looks to go downtown yet again but miscues it badly. The ball fall in front of the fielder coming in from long off. A dot ball.

SIX! WOW! Pooja Vastrakar is injecting some life into this batting display. On off and in the swinging arc. Pooja Vastrakar thumps it right back over the bowler's head and the ball travels a long way. Maximum!
A length ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar slashes hard at it and gets it over extra cover. Tahlia McGrath runs in from deep point and puts in the dive to her right and cuts it off. Two taken.
Fullish ball, on off and this is drilled down to long off. No run taken.
FOUR! Full and straight, Darlington just misses then yorker and Pooja Vastrakar takes full advantage. She smokes it back over the bowler's head and picks up a boundary.
Hannah Darlington to bowl the final over.
Flatter one, on middle and sliding in with the angle. Rajeshwari Gayakwad misses the block and gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
This is fired in full again and on middle. Pooja Vastrakar brings out the helicopter shot now. She gets it down to long on for a single.
Flighted delivery, on off again. Pooja Vastrakar drives it down to long off and doesn't take the single yet again.
Dragged down, on middle and leg. Pooja Vastrakar works it through mid-wicket and picks up a brace. The 100 comes up as well for India Women.
Tossed up, full and on off. Pooja Vastrakar winds up but cant get under it and ends up swatting it to long off. No run taken.
Fired in full and on middle. Vastrakar digs it out towards mid on.
A length ball, on middle. Gayakwad defends it out.
Good looking shot for no run. Outside off and tapped to cover-point.

FIVE WIDES! These are golden extras for India Women and they'll take them with both hands. Down the leg side and swinging further down. The ball beats the keeper and races away into the fine leg fence.
Full and wide, Gayakwad with a stylish leave.
WIDE! On leg and sliding down. Rajeshwari Gayakwad looks to flick but misses. Wided.
On off and driven down the ground for a single.
FOUR! Good-length ball, around off. Pooja Vastrakar hangs back and thrashes it through covers for a bloundary.
SIX! WOW! A length ball, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar steps out and swings freely. She lifts it way, way over the long on fence for a biggie. The first one of the night as well.
WIDE! Back of a length, way down the leg side. The keeper, Alyssa Healy does well to get a hand on it.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is the last batter to come in. Also, Nicola Carey comes back into the attack. Her figures read 2-0-7-1 so far.

OUT! Cleaned up! Sophie Molineux gets second wicket of the night. This is fired in full and on middle and leg. Renuka Singh clears her front leg and looks to heave it on the leg side. The ball sneaks under her bat and crashes into the stumps. Just one wicket remaining now for India Women.
Shorter delivery, on off. Pooja Vastrakar punches it off the back foot through covers for another one.
Tossed up, on off and heaved down to long on for a run.
Flighted ball, on off and defended out by Renuka Singh.
On off and pushed through covers for a single.
Very full, around off. Pooja Vastrakar looks to drive but the ball sneaks under her willow.
Who will come in now? It's Renuka Singh.

OUT! TIMBER! Wickets are falling like a pack of cards for India Women. Loopy ball, on middle, turning back in sharply. Shikha Pandey goes back in the crease and looks to punch but misses. The ball goes through the gate and rattles the furniture behind her. India Women are eight down now.
Loopy ball, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted ball, on off. Pandey drills it to mid on for one.
Short and on off. Pandey pushes it to extra cover.
Shikha Pandey comes in at number 9.

OUT! RUN OUT! Loopy ball, on middle. Sharma gets low on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg. Perry there runs to her right and dives to stop the ball. The fielder from deep mid-wicket collects the ball and throws it to the striker's end. Meanwhile, there is a huge mix-up in the middle as both the batters end up at the non-striker's end. Alyssa Healy collects the ball and whips the bails off. The umpires take it upstairs to check who reached the non-striker's end first. Replay shows that Pooja Vastrakar grounded her bat first. So, Deepti Sharma will have to walk back to the pavilion.

A run out review is sent upstairs by the umpires. It is a RUN OUT for sure but the umpires are unsure about who is run out and hence, the third umpire is called into action. The replay shows that Pooja Vastrakar did cross Deepti Sharma and hence, Deepti Sharma has to make the long walk back to the pavilion.
Floats it up, on middle and leg. Deepti Sharma looks to tuck it on the leg side. She inside-edges it onto the pads.
Ashleigh Gardner (3-0-9-0) to bowl out.
Overpitched delivery, on middle. Sharma whips it through mid-wicket for one.
Short of a length, on middle and leg. Vastrakar works it to mid-wicket. She crosses ends.
Touch fuller, on middle. Sharma flicks it to square leg for a single.
Full and on leg, Pooja Vastrakar looks to flick but misses again. She gets hit on the pads and the batters take a leg bye.
On the pads, Pooja Vastrakar looks to flick but misses. She gets hit on the pads.
Good-length ball, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar knocks it back to the bowler.
Hannah Darlington is brought into the attack now.
Back of a length, around off. Pooja Vastrakar pats it in front of cover. She retains the strike by picking up a single.
On a good length, on the pads, Deepti Sharma works it to square leg for a single.
Length ball, on middle. Sharma drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Slower ball again, on middle. Deepti Sharma defends it out.
On middle. Vastrakar pushes it to covers for a single.
A slower one, on middle Sharma clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball, on middle. Deepti Sharma sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Full and on middle, Pooja Vastrakar nudges it on the leg side for a single.
On middle blocked out from the crease.
An appeal for an LBW turned down! Loopy ball, on middle. Sharma looks to sweep but misses. She gets hit on the gloves. The ball rolls to the off side and the batters take a leg bye.
Short and outside off, Sharma taps it to point.
Loopy ball, outside off. Sharma looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
WIDE! Tosses it up, down the leg side. Deepti looks to sweep but misses. Wided.
Pooja Vastrakar is in at number 8. Ashleigh Gardner (2-0-7-0) is back into the attack.

OUT! TIMBER! You miss, I hit stuff! Ghosh had to go for it, she comes down the track and swings, Carey shortens the length, it stays low, goes beneath the bat and hits the tumps. 100 now looks difficult.
Slower one outside off, Ghosh swings but misses.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Outside off, this one stayed low. Ghosh looks to push it through covers but it goes off the inner half on the leg side for one.
Outside off, this is guided through point for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket for one.
Nicola Carey is brought into the attack for the first time today.
A single to end as this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, this is guided to point.
FOUR! Nice and fine! On the pads, Sharma plays it nice and fine towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Floats it up outside off, Ghosh looks to drive, this goes off the outside edge to backward point.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A single to end as this is guided through point.
On off, this is worked to mid on.
Deepti Sharma is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! It is all falling apart here for India and pretty quickly! A run out is the last thing they would have wanted! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. They take one, Yastika Bhatia wants a second and takes off, she is halfway down the wicket but then is sent back. The fielder picks the ball up and fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off in a flash.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Almost another one! Bhatia skips down the track, the length is shortened. She swings but gets and inside edge onto the pads.
Ashleigh Gardner is brought back into the attack.
On off, turning back in. Ghosh looks to push at it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Richa Ghosh is in at number 6.

OUT! STUMPED! So just as the momentum seemed to be shifting, Australia strike and it is the big wicket of the Indian skipper! Beautifully bowled! Done in the flight and dip. This is tossed up nicely and around off, Kaur comes down the track, the ball dips right at the end. She swings, it sneaks under the bat and Healy does the rest. India in huge trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Georgia Wareham

Commentary.Commentary: Good fielding! On middle, Kaur sweeps it through square leg. Perry in the deep, runs to her left, dives and keeps it down to two.
On middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Runs coming now for India! Shorter and outside off, Bhatia looks to cut, it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Georgia Wareham is brought into the attack now.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Harmanpreet Kaur. Banged in, halfway down the pitch, with no real pace on it. Kaur waits for it and picks it up and muscles it into the square leg fence. 15 off the over.
FOUR! A loosener from Ellyse Perry. Short and wide. Kaur gets on top of the bounce and thrashes it through the point region for a boundary.
A good-length ball, around off and jagging back in. Kaur keeps it out.
WIDE! This is down the leg side, Kaur looks to repeat the trick again but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
FOUR! Perry drifts onto the pads. Harmanpreet Kaur just shuffles across her stumps and tickles it fine. The ball races into the fine leg fence.
A length ball, on middle. Bhatia picks it up and heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Ellyse Perry comes back into the attack.
A low full toss, on off. Kaur drives it to wide long off for a single.
Third dot on the trot. On off and defended out by Bhatia.
Flighted ball, on middle and leg. Bhatia works it to mid on.
On off and pushed to mid off.
Tossed up again and Kaur works it to long on for another one.

On the pads and Bhatia pulls it to deep square leg for a single. They look for two but decide against it, The fielder throws the ball to Alyssa Healy who whips the bails off in a flash. The umpire take it upstairs and the replay shows Harmanpreet Kaur's dive saved her.
A run out appeal has been sent upstairs. Replay rolls in and shows Harmanpreet Kaur was well inside the crease when Alyssa Healy whipped the bails off. The third umpire's verdict is NOT OUT!
Floated delivery, outside off and turning in. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it down the ground for a single.
Ashleigh Gardner comes into the attack.
Nicely flighted again and Bhatia pushes it towards mid off. End of the Powerplay, India Women are 25/3.
Tossed up, on middle. Kaur eases it down to long on for one.
Full and on middle, patted back to the bowler.
Yastika Bhatia walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is what dot balls do to you! The pressure was building and Jemimah Rodrigues decides to step out and play the slog sweep. Flighted ball, on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball and looks to force the big shot. She ends up completely miscuing it towards mid on. Hannah Darlington takes a simple catch and India Women are in a spot of bother.
Commentary.Howout: c Hannah Darlington b Sophie Molineux

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely tossed up, on off and defended back to the bowler.
On a length, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to cut but bottom edges it back to the keeper.
A length ball, on top of off. Kaur pats it towards cover-point.
FOUR! And again, another classy shot from Kaur. Back of a length, on middle and leg. Kaur turns it over square leg this time and gets another boundary.
FOUR! Elegantly played by Harmanpreet Kaur. A length ball, sliding into leg. Kaur just uses her wrists to flick it over mid-wicket and picks up a boundary.
Good-length ball, on middle. Kaur taps it back onto the deck.
Just out of reach! On the pads and Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it uppishly towards the left of mid-wicket. Ashleigh Gardner puts in the dive but just can't reach. They get one.
Drop and run. Back of a length, on off. Kaur hops back and taps it on the off side for a quick single. Tayla Vlaeminck has a shy at the stumps and hits but Jemimah Rodrigues is well in.
Shortish ball by Perry on middle, Kaur hooks this one to square leg for a single. Superb over from Ellyse Perry. Just 2 runs from it.
Short of a length, on off. Kaur punches it towards covers.
Fuller in length, outside off. Kaur drives it straight to mid off.

On a good length, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues gets low and looks to drive. The ball goes off the outside edge and races away to third man. Nicola Carey runs to her left and dives to make a brilliant stop. Saves three runs for her side.
Good-length ball, on middle. Rodrigues looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge towards point.
On a length, on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues tucks it to mid-wicket.
Here comes the first change in the attack. Ellyse Perry comes in to bowl.
Good-length ball, on off. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to defend but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge.
The skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur is now at the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Both the openers are sent packing. Good-length ball, outside off. Verma makes room for herself and swings her bat across the line but completely miscues. The ball goes off the top edge towards mid on. Hannah Darlington is present over there and takes the catch without any trouble. Australia Women right on top and Tayla Vlaeminck bags her second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Hannah Darlington b Tayla Vlaeminck

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, Jemimah Rodrigues tucks it to square leg for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues taps it to point.
Good-length ball, outside off. Rodrigues looks to cut. The ball goes off the bottom half of the bat back to the keeper.
Short of a length, outside off. Jemimah rocks back and cuts it past point for a brace.
Very full, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it through cover-point and retains the strike picking up a single.
Full and on middle, Verma nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fired in, full and on middle. Verma digs it out to mid on.
Quicker one, on off stump. Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and cuts it towards cover-point for a quick single and gets off the mark.
Flatter one, on middle. Verma turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Verma pats it back to the bowler.
Jemimah Rodrigues is in early, at number 3. Sophie Molineux to bowl from the other end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tayla Vlaeminck draws first blood. She gets rid of the big fish early. Bowls a full ball, on middle. Smriti Mandhana swings her bat across the line. The ball goes off the inside half of her bat towards mid-wicket. Nicola Carey is stationed over there. She moves to her left and grabs the catch diving forward.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicola Carey b Tayla Vlaeminck

Commentary.Commentary: Width on offer, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid off.
WIDE! Length ball, down the leg side. Mandhana looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Fuller ball, on off. Mandhana smashes it hard but finds the extra cover fielder.
NO BALL! Good-length ball, on off. Verma taps it towards backward point for a single. Tayla Vlaeminck has overstepped. Free hit coming up...
On a length, on off. Verma prods and pushes it towards covers. She takes off for a single but is sent back by Mandhana.
WIDE! Length ball, down the leg side. Verma looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Full again, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards mid off for a single. Smriti Mandhana and India Women are up and running!
Fuller in length, on middle. Mandhana pushes it towards mid on. She looks for a quick single but is sent back by Verma.

We are ready for play. The umpires are out in the middle along with the Australia Women players. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are set to open the innings for India Women. Tayla Vlaeminck has the new ball in hand. Let's play...

PITCH REPORT - Saba Karim reckons that the wicket looks good to bat on. Mentions that the wicket looks pretty hard and it should be fun for the batters to play on this wicket. Informs that there shouldn't be much on offer for the seamers off the deck and it looks like a proper T20 surface.
The skipper of India Women, Harmanpreet Kaur says that it is always good to accept the challenges put up by the opponent. Mentions that they too are going with the same eleven.

The skipper of Australia Women, Meg Lanning says that they will bowl first. Mentions that if they can get their plans right and execute them well, they can put India under pressure. Informs that there are no changes to the side.

India Women (UNCHANGED playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur(c), Yastika Bhatia, Richa Ghosh(w), Pooja Vastrakar, Deepti Sharma, Shikha Pandey, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Renuka Singh.

Australia Women (UNCHANGED playing XI) -  Alyssa Healy(w), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning(c), Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, Nicola Carey, Sophie Molineux, Georgia Wareham, Hannah Darlington, Tayla Vlaeminck.
TOSS - Australia Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

India Women are set to lock horns against Australia Women in the second T20I of the three-match T20I series. The opening T20I turned out to be a damp squib as rain played spoilsport. India Women displayed brilliant batting especially Jemimah Rodrigues who raced to 49 in no time. The hosts struggled to contain India Women's scoring rate and will look to put a better performance in this match. The multi-format series stands 7-5 at the moment in favor of the Aussies. It's a do-or-die situation for the visitors who have been on top of things since the third ODI. Will India Women win and level the multi-format series? Or will Australia Women clinch the multi-format series? We shall find out. On that note, welcome to the coverage.
... MATCH DAY ...
